turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I record my university lectures on my phone? I can't write fast enough.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, the built-in voice recorder works well. Sit nearer the front so the lecturer's voice is clearer than people around you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do I need to ask permission?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It's polite and often required. Check the course rules or just ask the lecturer after class. Most say yes for personal study.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Some recorder apps transcribe automatically, and you can search the text later for keywords.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that would save my life during exams.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Just don't skip actually listening in the room. The recording is a backup, not a replacement.
